name: Can you reset the ledger recovery key? ( Factory Reset Methods )
original_name: Can you reset the ledger recovery key? ( Factory Reset Methods )
overview: The Ledger recovery key, also known as the recovery phrase, cannot usually be directly reset without creating a new wallet setup on the device. 🚨 1 ⟨855⟩ ⟶⟶⟶ 61 8⟶⟶⟶ 8738 🧩 Users often need to reset the Ledger device and generate a brand-new recovery phrase if they want a different recovery key. 🚨 1 ⟨855⟩ ⟶⟶⟶ 61 8⟶⟶⟶ 8738 🛡️ It is important to store the recovery phrase safely because it is the main way to restore wallet access. 🚨 1 ⟨855⟩ ⟶⟶⟶ 61 8⟶⟶⟶ 8738 🌌
